# Context Optimizer
## Process
1. Run `forge context --json --verbose` and list the heaviest harness, files and findings.
2. For each finding, propose the smallest edit that keeps the guidance available:
   - move how-to sections from always-loaded files into skills (loaded on demand);
   - add `paths:` (Claude Code) or `globs:` (Cursor) so stack rules load only for matching files;
   - shorten skill and agent descriptions to one "when to use" sentence;
   - replace copied text with an import (`@AGENTS.md`);
   - remove MCP servers the repo does not use (`forge mcp remove`).
3. Make edits only after approval, then re-run `forge context` and report the before/after estimate.

Never delete rules or safety guidance to save tokens; move them. Token figures are estimates; say so.
